The master asks slave 1 to "Write Single Coil": set coil 00001 to ON

── Data details ──
00001 = ON

── Byte-by-byte ──
00 01  Transaction identifier  Sequence number 0x0001 assigned by the master to this exchange; the response echoes it
00 00  Protocol identifier     0x0000 = standard Modbus protocol
00 06  Length                  6 more bytes follow (unit identifier + data)
01     Unit identifier         slave address: device 1
05     Function code           0x05 = Write Single Coil
00 00  Address                 protocol address 0, PLC address 00001
FF 00  Write value             0xFF00 = ON

── Technical details ──
Transport: Modbus TCP (12 bytes total)
Transaction ID: 0x0001
Protocol ID: 0x0000
Length field: 6 (6 bytes actually follow)
Unit ID: 1
Function: 0x05 (Write Single Coil)
Address: 0 (PLC 00001)
Write value: 0xFF00 (ON)
PDU: 05 00 00 FF 00
